sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-PSV2 key (RB-PSV2) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the iron mesh doors in the Federal State Reserve Agency base underground supply warehouse.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 3 of these, or 3 of the other RB-PSP and RB-PSV keys need to be found in raid for the quest Safe Corridor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In the Common fund stash (Shturman's crate)
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: This key opens the north-east caged off storage area in the Underground Storage Bunkers on Reserve (Highlighted in green). There is one unlockable door at the north and south end of the closed caged room.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Three Medical supply crates
- One Technical supply crate
